definitions.gloss: lecture meeting; public talk; speaking event
definitions.explanation: A formal event where a speaker gives a talk or lecture to an audience. Composed of 講演 (lecture, public speech) + 会 (meeting, gathering).

examples.japanese: {講演会|こうえんかい}に{参加|さんか}した。
{有名|ゆうめい}な{教授|きょうじゅ}の{講演会|こうえんかい}が{開|ひら}かれる。
examples.english: A lecture by a famous professor will be held.

examples.japanese: {市民|しみん}ホールで{健康|けんこう}をテーマにした{講演会|こうえんかい}が{行|おこな}われ、{多|おお}くの{人|ひと}が{集|あつ}まった。
examples.english: A lecture on health was held at the civic hall, and many people gathered.

notes:
USAGE:
{講演会|こうえんかい} refers to a formal public speaking event, typically with an invited speaker addressing an audience on a specific topic. It is common in academic, business, and community settings.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {講演会|こうえんかい}を{開|ひら}く (to hold a lecture)
- {講演会|こうえんかい}に{出席|しゅっせき}する (to attend a lecture)
- {講演会|こうえんかい}の{講師|こうし} (lecturer at a speaking event)

SIMILAR WORDS:
セミナー is a seminar, usually more interactive. シンポジウム is a symposium with multiple speakers. {講演|こうえん} alone refers to the lecture itself rather than the event.
